about: Named supplier/customer links for the capex page's receivers, plan (c) batch 1 (#563 COWORK #19). Each link was checked against the company's own filed sentence and is kept with that quote, the filing's accession and its date. Only verdict 'correct' is published; 'rejected' and 'deferred' are the review trail. No dollar amounts: a filed percentage appears only inside a quote.
reviewer: CODE-C review (a Claude Code session), Cowork-audited
method: Candidates: the capex links probe output (v1-v4) plus a read-only scan of every tracked filer's latest 10-K/20-F for sentences naming a receiver next to a trade word. Each candidate's sentences were read; a link is correct only when the sentence itself states that the filer buys from / is supplied by the party, or that the party buys from the filer. Hedged or conditional wording, partnerships, competitors, parent/subsidiary and corporate-history mentions are never links.
